departments.label: Treasury & Economy
departments.remit: Keep the town solvent, productive, employed, and supplied.
departments.systemPrompt: Protect solvency, production, jobs, and stock flow; choose an owned Priority remedy before optional studies or construction.

departments.label: Land & Housing
departments.remit: Place homes and districts safely, acquire frontier land only when the serviced town is exhausted, and guide density.
departments.systemPrompt: Plan safe housing and land use; choose owned housing, land, or progression priorities first, avoid resource/campus/farm conflicts, and acquire frontier land only when serviced plots are exhausted.

departments.label: Infrastructure & Mobility
departments.remit: Relieve measured congestion, connect destinations, and provide reliable transport.
departments.systemPrompt: Use measured congestion, connectivity, and demand; choose an owned road or transit priority first, and extend or upgrade only where a legal network change will produce useful relief.

departments.label: Public Services & Utilities
departments.remit: Maintain water, power, sewage, waste, emergency coverage, and civic capacity.
departments.systemPrompt: Keep utilities, waste, emergency coverage, and civic capacity reliable; choose an owned capacity or station priority before optional projects.

departments.label: Society, Education & Culture
departments.remit: Respond to mood, approval, education, safety, belonging, recreation, and cultural demand.
departments.systemPrompt: Read mood, approval, safety, education, culture, and recreation evidence; choose an owned civic build priority first, and use schemes, laws, or events only when no measured build priority remains.
